meta.source: v3 UI proposal approved by Eduardo (October 2026): Cinza Névoa layers, Branco Pérola cards, Verde Esmeralda, Ouro #FFEB97 and Marrom Luxo #583714, high-relief pills and border neon. Replaces the v1 facade palette (champagne, bronze, walnut, stone). Night theme derived from the earlier brown-and-gold proposal.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cinza Névoa: the deepest layer, the page ground of every web and app screen. Night: deep brown.

tokens.name: surface-panel
tokens.usage: The middle layer: large panels and sheets that hold cards, one step above `surface`.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Branco Pérola: the top layer. Cards, tiles, nav bar, chips and white pill buttons.

tokens.name: surface-deboss
tokens.usage: The sunken pill behind the active nav item (low relief).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Marrom Luxo as the text color: headings and body on `surface`, `surface-panel` and `surface-raised` (8.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions and metadata on `surface`, `surface-panel`, `surface-raised` and `surface-deboss` (5.2:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Input and control outlines; 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: hairline
tokens.usage: Decorative dividers inside cards and lists. Not a control border.

tokens.name: emerald
tokens.usage: Verde Esmeralda: the primary action and the active state (Reservar, selected day, toggle on, FAB). Gradient start; text on it is `on-emerald`. 5.2:1 as text on `surface` in Day.

tokens.name: emerald-deep
tokens.usage: The dark end of the emerald gradient and the silk shadows on emerald cards. Never a flat fill on its own.

tokens.name: on-emerald
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `emerald` fills (6.2:1); `gold` also reads on emerald (5.4:1) for titles.

tokens.name: gold
tokens.usage: Ouro: highlights, the one special card per screen, price tags and the secondary pill button. Text on it is `on-gold`. Never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: gold-deep
tokens.usage: The warm end of the gold gradient and the neon color on brown buttons. Decorative, not text.

tokens.name: on-gold
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `gold` fills (8.9:1).

tokens.name: brown
tokens.usage: Marrom Luxo as a fill: the tertiary pill button and dark accents. Text on it is `on-brown`.

tokens.name: on-brown
tokens.usage: Text on `brown` fills (8.9:1 Day).

tokens.name: neon
tokens.usage: The neon stroke that runs around a button's border on hover and lights fully when clicked or selected. Decorative light, never text.

tokens.name: neon-hot
tokens.usage: The bright head of the running neon stroke.

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Translucent panel (with `blur-glass`) floating over imagery: the web stage panel, menus, modal panels. `ink` stays legible over any content.

tokens.name: glass-bar
tokens.usage: The app tab bar and floating bars (with `blur-glass`); icons in `ink-muted`, active in `emerald`.

tokens.name: glass-hover
tokens.usage: Translucent shading of a nav item or menu row on hover.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed layer behind a modal or bottom sheet (`blur-scrim`). Never behind menus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus outline, 2px with a 4px offset; 5:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: Hero lines and the name set in type. Uppercase.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Web hero card titles and app screen titles (Olá, Helena; Agenda). Sentence case.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and tile titles, sentence case.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Wide-tracked uppercase labels above titles, in `emerald` or `ink-muted`.

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Saúde, beleza e bem-estar em um só lugar.
styles.usage: The one sentence under a hero title.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Escolha a sala, o horário e pronto.
styles.usage: Default card text; one sentence per card.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button and chip labels: one word whenever possible.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, tile counts and tab captions in `ink-muted`.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gaps.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Chip gaps, tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Gaps between buttons and list rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Inner gaps in tiles; gap between app cards.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Side margin of app screens; tile padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding and the gap between web cards.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between sections on mobile; how far an overlapping element may hang past its panel.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between sections on desktop; stage padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Amenity icon tiles, thumbnails and small squares.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: App tiles, list cards and booking rows.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards (web and app) and feature cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Panels, bottom sheets and the web stage panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Every button, chip, toggle, nav bar, nav item, week strip and tab bar.

shadow.note: Three lift levels for layers, `rim` for the top edge, relief recipes for pill controls and `deboss` for pressed and active states.

tokens.name: lift-1
tokens.usage: Level 1: small elements resting on a card (avatars, thumbnails).

tokens.name: lift-2
tokens.usage: Level 2: cards and tiles floating over a panel.

tokens.name: lift-3
tokens.usage: Level 3: the panel, the nav bar, the tab bar, emerald feature cards and anything that overlaps another layer.

tokens.name: rim
tokens.usage: The light-catching top edge every raised surface carries, combined with a `lift-*`.

tokens.name: relief-pearl
tokens.usage: High relief for white pill buttons, chips, icon buttons and knobs.

tokens.name: relief-emerald
tokens.usage: High relief for emerald pill buttons, the FAB and selected chips.

tokens.name: relief-gold
tokens.usage: High relief for gold pill buttons, price tags and the avatar.

tokens.name: relief-brown
tokens.usage: High relief for brown pill buttons.

tokens.name: deboss
tokens.usage: Low relief: the pressed state of every button and the sunken pill of the active nav item.

tokens.name: neon-glow
tokens.usage: Static glow for a selected element where the animated ring cannot be drawn.

blur.note: Backdrop blur amounts. Use as blur(var(--blur-…)) inside backdrop-filter.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: `glass` panels, menus and the tab bar.

tokens.name: blur-hover
tokens.usage: Nav item hover shading.

tokens.name: blur-scrim
tokens.usage: The `scrim` behind modals.
